rows.note: This is the all-purpose term when “cocoa” means the unsweetened powder used in cooking or baking.

example.english: I need cocoa powder to make a chocolate cake.
example.traditional: 我整朱古力蛋糕要落可可粉。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zing2 zyu1 gu1 lik6 daan6 gou1 jiu3 lok6 ho2 ho2 fan2

rows.note: Use this for the prepared hot cocoa drink rather than the dry powder.

example.english: I want a cup of cocoa.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 bui1 jit6 ho2 ho2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the dried cacao seeds, not cocoa powder or a drink.

example.english: These cocoa beans have already been fermented and dried, so we can use them to make chocolate.
example.traditional: 呢啲可可豆已經發酵同曬乾，可以攞去整朱古力。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 ho2 ho2 dau6 ji5 ging1 faat3 gaau3 tung4 saai3 gon1 ho2 ji5 lo2 heoi3 zing2 zyu1 gu1 lik6
